# Claim 1 — verified

At the paper-default Gaussian configuration (n=100, m=1000, eta=1, lambda=1e-4, nu²=1), all six seeds overfit early, retain poor population performance long after fitting, and finally generalize below epsilon=.01. Median t1 is 213 and median t2 is 22,871.5, a 22,666-step / 107.14× separation. Population loss immediately after fit remains at least .8096; late loss is at most .000909. A dimension sweep gives limiting-loss slope -.932 with R²=.9999, supporting the asymptotic direction.
